visual_identity.core_identity: A predatory shapechanger disguised as a wooden chest, revealing itself through a toothed lid-mouth, tongue, and organic seams.
visual_identity.silhouette: Recognizable chest shape with lid lifted as an upper jaw, box body as lower jaw, and one or two subtle pseudopod forms.
visual_identity.head_features: The chest itself becomes the head: lid-mouth with irregular teeth and a long tongue, no separate animal skull.
visual_identity.body_shape: Wooden chest form distorted by flexible organic joints while retaining hinges, boards, and treasure-box proportions.
visual_identity.surface: Wood grain kept minimal; fleshy mouth interior outlined simply without heavy shading.
visual_identity.shape_lock: Draw one complete rectangular treasure chest as the entire creature silhouette. The hinged lid itself forms the upper jaw and the box body forms the lower jaw; tongue and any pseudopod emerge from chest seams only. No separate head, torso, animal legs, or creature body may appear behind or beneath the chest.
visual_identity.limb_structure: No separate biological limbs. The chest body remains one object; tongue/pseudopod forms may emerge only from lid, seam, hinge, or panel structure.

accuracy_checks: reads as chest before monster details

reference.notes: Reference material controls creature identity, anatomy, and silhouette only; Black-Ink controls the final coloring-book rendering style.
